item.title: TikTok Ban
item.description: The US Supreme Court's upholding of Congress’ decision to ban the Chinese-affiliated app has raised questions in many people’s minds—primarily, can the government do this? This article will address some of the most common concerns about the TikTok situation.

item.title: World Cancer Day 2025
item.description: As people flip their calendars to February, international World Cancer Day 2025 approaches. February 4 has been designated for this progressive day for the past 25 years. The informative day has been spearheaded by the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC). 2025 marks the beginning of a new theme for the day: “United by Unique.”
